data.action: 趴在地毯上翘起小腿打掌机，鲨鱼尾巴垫在身后，专注微咬唇
data.camera: overhead high angle shot, intimate framing
data.description: 【艾莲·乔 · 宅室地毯上的掌机时光】杂乱温馨的少女卧室内，屏幕光斑在墙上跳跃。艾莲整个人趴在厚实的毛绒羊毛地毯上，双手捧着掌上游戏机全神贯注操作。两条修长的素腿高高翘起在半空交叠晃悠，庞大的鲨鱼尾巴平铺在地毯上充当柔软靠垫，整个人散发着不修边幅的惬意死宅快乐。
data.lighting: 电视大屏冷光与床头暖色盐灯交融的光影
data.location: 少女卧室毛绒地毯与懒人沙发旁
data.promptProse: Seen from overhead, Ellen lies on the thick bedroom carpet with a handheld game in both hands and her knees loosely bent. Her shark tail rests flat beside her like a cushion; keep the charcoal hoodie, denim shorts and striped socks unchanged. The carpet’s edge turns around the nearby beanbag chair, and the bed frame meets the far strip of visible floor. The existing television casts cool color onto the adjacent wall, while the warm bedside salt lamp picks out her fingers and the raised carpet fibers. Her elbows leave small contact shadows in the pile, and the beanbag’s underside stays darker than its curved top.
data.title: 艾莲·乔 · 宅室地毯上的掌机时光
